summary: Iter68 — Server-side Customer Search verified end-to-end. All 11 backend pytest cases in test_iter68_customer_search.py pass (legacy no-params shape, paginated envelope, limit cap 200, q partial match across name/phone/gstin/customer_code, case-insensitive, regex metachar escaping, no duplicates, ids force-include with dedup, cross-tenant isolation, skip/has_more, empty-q pagination). Public URL verified: /api/customers returns list of 7842 (legacy) and /api/customers?limit=3 returns paginated envelope. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: /customers debounced search (typing 'a' narrowed 7842→2796 in ~300ms), Prev disabled at page 0, Next advances to different rows, Prev restores. TripForm /trips/new async customer picker fetched 50 options for 'a', selecting one populated the ship-site picker. Trips/Invoices/Reports pages load with no error banners — backward-compat legacy list shape preserved. with_balance=true also still returns legacy list shape (7842).
critical_code_review_comments: customers.py list_customers: page_limit/page_skip is computed twice (once inside the paginated branch, once at return). Minor duplication — extract to a single computation before the branch. Non-blocking.
The `ids` id-lookup uses base_filter (tenant-scoped) — tenant isolation is enforced correctly here. Test confirms A's id under B's headers is excluded.
regex `^{safe}` on `id` field is an OK optimization for exact/prefix id lookup via q, but ensure this doesn't cause confusion since the primary id-forced-include path is via `ids=`.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST customers with UNIQUE prefix IT68_* — no cleanup performed (Iter68 test pattern; low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter68 customer server-side search is stable. Ensure future changes to /api/customers keep the paginated_mode branch guard (any of q/limit/skip/ids). with_balance is intentionally NOT in that tuple so CustomerHistory's /api/customers?with_balance=true keeps returning legacy array. AsyncSearchableSelect input testid is `{dataTestId}-input`, options are `{dataTestId}-opt-{id}`.
